hook.text: When does a page feel loaded? Google says it's when the biggest visible element appears.

buildup.text: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) measures the time until the main image or text block renders.

discovery.text: A good LCP is under 2.5 seconds. Anything slower signals a poor user experience to Google.

twist.text: A huge hero image can tank your LCP if it loads from a slow server without optimization.

climax.text: LCP became the most important Core Web Vital for measuring perceived load speed.

punchline.text: The biggest element sets the pace for the page.

quiz.question: What does LCP measure?
options: Time until the largest element renders
